_about: Rules applied on top of the AI's reading of the photo. Order: specialist (waste type or hazard word) > bulky booking > bin day > AI says not a fly-tip > hold types > clear now. If the AI is unsure, a person reviews it. Waste type names must match the Defra list exactly.
specialist_note: Possible hazardous waste. Send a licensed specialist team.
hold_note: Bags and trade waste may hold evidence. Officer to inspect before clearance.
clear_note: No evidence expected. Book a crew.
unsure_note: AI not confident. Check the photo.

collection_day.text: Bin day in this ward. Bags are likely awaiting collection.

bulky_booking.text: Bulky collection booked today at this address.
